name: FirstMagic ~Hajimari no Mahou~
source:
──I'll tell you bluntly. I like my teacher.

Called by her student Lumina, I have to make a choice.

"But the teacher doesn't accept it. So ... I'll stun you with the magic you want."

──Choose the magic you taught me for the first time?

There were four types of magic that Lumina presented: "fire," "water," "ice," and "thunder."
... the magic I first taught her ... it was ...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6670]NovelGame[/url]]
